rules.name: BEGIN A DANCE OF DECADES
rules.text: Whenever you would play a Power Card, you may instead pay any amount of Energy onto the card to make it an impending card ( [Impending] ), setting it aside out of play for use on a future turn. (It doesn't provide Elements. It's still your Power Card, so it can be forgotten while it's impending.)
rules.turn:
-- "Whenever you would play a Power Card, you may instead ..."
-- (the "may" is decided before the play, in choose-cards)
choose-cards, spirit:special S dance-of-decades, turns-done N, wants S P N
  ?[rng] R
  !(may R)
  ~dance-ask S P R N
turn, turns-done N, >dance-ask S P R N, is R yes, { play-card S P _ => ~make-impending S P }
-- "... pay any amount of Energy onto the card to make it an impending card,
--  setting it aside out of play for use on a future turn."
make-impending S P, energy S E, turns-done N
  ?[rng] A
  !(upto E A)
  ~impending-pay S P N A
impending-pay S P N C, is C A
  +energy-spend S A
  +energy-on S P A
  +impending S P N
  ~move P impending
-- "(It doesn't provide Elements.)" -- nothing to write: no `played` tuple
-- exists for it, and Elements are counted from `played`.
rules.evidence: Seed 7: dance-ask yes -> make-impending dances quake -> impending-pay ... 0 -> energy-on dances quake 0; no `played`, so fire-elements 0 0 on turn 1. Seeds 1-4 decline: play-card dances quake 0, played, fire-elements 0 1.
rules.notes: 'would play ... instead' is an exception on the base `play-card` episode, so the cost payment is skipped too. 'You may' can't live inside an exception (they intercept unconditionally within their context), so the decision is a choice in an earlier `choose-cards` step, and the exception's context starts after a 'yes'. That requires the base to split 'decide which cards' from 'play them'. 'Doesn't provide Elements' needs no rule, because Elements are counted from `played` tuples. 'Any amount' is a choice over a 0..Energy js generator. Forgetting an impending card is not modeled.

rules.name: RHYTHMIC POWER BUILDS TO A CATACLYSMIC CRESCENDO
rules.text: When you gain Energy from your Presence Track, also gain [{{{width}}}px] Energy onto each Power Card made [Impending] on a previous turn. If any [Impending] now have Energy on them at least equal to their cost, discard that Energy and play them. (This costs no card plays.)
rules.turn:
#acc energy-on-card : power @sum
energy-on S P A / energy-on-card P A
-- "When you gain Energy from your Presence Track, also gain 1 Energy onto each
--  Power Card made Impending on a previous turn."
gain-energy-from-track S X, spirit:special S crescendo, turns-done N
  at P impending, impending S P M, lt M N
  +energy-on S P 1
-- "If any Impending now have Energy on them at least equal to their cost,
--  discard that Energy and play them. (This costs no card plays.)"
spirit-phase, spirit:special S crescendo, turns-done N, >gain-energy-phase N
  at P impending, impending S P M, energy-on-card P E, power:cost P C, ge E C
  ~crescendo-play S P N
crescendo-play S P N, ~move P in-play
turn, turns-done N, >crescendo-play S P N, ^played S P
rules.evidence: Seed 8: 3 Energy put on Quake (cost 4), +1 on turn 2 -> crescendo-play dances quake 1, played, used-on-turn dances quake 1. Seed 14: 2 + 1 + 1 -> crescendo-play on turn 2 (third turn). Seed 7: 0 + 1 + 1 stays impending. Once played, no further feeding.
rules.notes: The wiki text lost the printed per-turn amount to a template glitch ([{{{width}}}px]); 1 is assumed. 'Previous turn' needs turn numbers (impending S P M with M < current). 'Discard that Energy' is implicit, since the card leaves `impending`. Played cards never leave `in-play` (no Time Passes discard in core).

base_ext: Multiple turns (turns-done counter), Energy as @sum with negative spends, Spirit Phase steps gain-energy (from a track value fact) / choose-cards / play-cards with turn-keyed play-card episodes that pay their cost, js-defs plus/neg/upto.
language_issues: Optional replacement ('you may instead') can't be an exception by itself, because exceptions are unconditional in their context; the choice must be made in an ordered earlier step and scope the exception, so the base has to separate deciding from doing.
`>play-card` / `>gain-energy-phase` without a turn key would also match earlier turns' episodes; every per-turn episode got a turn-number argument.
'Any amount of Energy' needs a js generator (`upto`) as the choice domain.
